name: woodpecker-server
title: Woodpecker CI (server)
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：前端 x86 构建后内嵌；CGO SQLite。

缺失功能：不配置 forge（Gitea/GitHub 等）无法启动；无内置账号体系。

额外依赖：持久化 /var/lib/woodpecker；WOODPECKER_HOST 必须是外部可访问 URL。

镜像说明：3.19.0；必须配置一个 forge（Gitea/GitHub 等）才能启动；`/var/lib/woodpecker` 持久化；8000 HTTP/9000 gRPC；自动生成 agent/grpc secret
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Frontend is built on x86 and embedded; CGO SQLite.

Missing features: Cannot start without a forge (Gitea/GitHub/etc.); no built-in account system.

Extra dependencies: Persist /var/lib/woodpecker; WOODPECKER_HOST must be an externally reachable URL.

Image notes: 3.19.0；必须配置一个 forge（Gitea/GitHub 等）才能启动；`/var/lib/woodpecker` 持久化；8000 HTTP/9000 gRPC；自动生成 agent/grpc secret

notes: 必须配置 forge，否则启动失败；自动生成 agent/grpc secret。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
